integrity: The proof separates prior Cayley-transform algebra from the new fixed-generator analysis. It uses the M-matrix resolvent, reversible spectral decomposition, and finite-state resolvent limit. The packaged exact-rational checker independently replays matrix identities and closed families without using numerical floating-point evidence as proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact diagonal-resolvent criterion holds for every finite Markov generator, but the single-interval threshold theorem and spectral bounds are proved only for irreducible reversible chains. Reducible chains and nonreversible positivity windows after a first sign loss are not classified. The theorem concerns exact end-step entrywise positivity, not nonlinear or stagewise positivity.
title: A resolvent-return law for Crank–Nicolson positivity on reversible Markov chains
